transcript:
Speaker A (AI): Hello, what is your profession?
Speaker B (Human): I doing teacher job.
Speaker A (AI): "I doing teacher job" नहीं, "I work as a teacher". [Not "I doing teacher job", "I work as a teacher".]
Speaker B (Human): I work as a teacher. Where do you live?
Speaker B (Human): I live at Jaipur.
Speaker A (AI): "At Jaipur" नहीं, "I live in Jaipur". [Not "At Jaipur", "I live in Jaipur".]
Speaker B (Human): I live in Jaipur. मेरी English बहुत weak है। [I live in Jaipur. My English is very weak.]
Speaker A (AI): कोई problem नहीं, इसलिए तो मैं यहाँ हूँ। क्या आपने कभी AI teacher के साथ practice की है? [No problem, that's why I'm here. Have you ever practiced with an AI teacher?]
Speaker B (Human): वो तो expensive होगा ना? [That must be expensive, right?]
Speaker A (AI): बिल्कुल नहीं। SpeakEasy normal English classes से 7 गुना सस्ता है। इसीलिए 1 करोड़ से ज़्यादा लोग SpeakEasy पर English practice कर रहे हैं। [Not at all. SpeakEasy is 7 times cheaper than normal English classes. That's why over 1 crore people practice English on SpeakEasy.]
Speaker B (Human): Practice के लिए time कैसे मिलेगा? [How will I find time to practice?]
Speaker A (AI): रोज़ सिर्फ 15 से 20 minute practice enough है। [Just 15 to 20 minutes of daily practice is enough.]
Speaker B (Human): Wow! मैं कैसे join करूँ? [Wow! How do I join?]
Speaker A (AI): बस install button दबाओ और SpeakEasy app download करो। [Just press the install button and download the SpeakEasy app.]
Speaker C (Voiceover): अभी SpeakEasy app download करें और फर्राटेदार English बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]

summary: A woman with weak English interacts with an AI avatar receptionist who corrects her grammatical mistakes. The AI explains that SpeakEasy is highly affordable, requires only 15-20 minutes of daily practice, and is used by over 1 crore people. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app and speak fluent English.
